prose: Reuters reports that Armadin, founded by Mandiant founder Kevin Mandia to build AI cybersecurity agents, raised a $255.5 million Series B led by a16z and Accel, valuing it above $2.5 billion. Armadin announced it Thursday. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; the article was not retrieved.
highlights: $255.5M Series B led by a16z and Accel
Founded by Mandiant founder Kevin Mandia
